The reason we make

Don't hide the cocoa.

Premium chocolate in India, starting from the bean. Not from imports.

Kalacho is a B2B bean-to-bar chocolate manufacturer. We work directly with South Indian cacao farmers and craft premium couverture at our own manufacturing unit. From selecting the beans to extracting our own cocoa butter, we keep the cocoa at the centre of the story.

Crafted at our unit in Hyderabad, Telangana
The bean-to-bar journey

Every step has a purpose.

From the harvest to the final setting, we make chocolate from the bean at our own unit. Scroll to walk the path.

01

From the farm

The journey begins with carefully selected Indian cocoa.

1
Step 1 of 11 · 01 From the farm

Cocoa Harvesting

Ripe pods are cut by hand from the trees, with long poles for the high branches, so only the ready fruit is picked.

2
Step 2 of 11 · 01 From the farm

Pod Collection

Harvested pods are gathered in baskets and carried from the trees to the work area, ready to be opened.

3
Step 3 of 11 · 01 From the farm

Bean Extraction

Pods are opened by hand and the white, pulp-covered beans are scooped out, ready for fermentation.

02

Developing character

Preparing the beans for the flavour to come.

4
Step 4 of 11 · 02 Developing character

Fermentation

Beans rest in covered wooden boxes while the pulp breaks down and the flavour that gives cocoa its character begins to develop.

5
Step 5 of 11 · 02 Developing character

Sun Drying

Fermented beans are spread on raised beds in the sun and turned by hand until dry, ready to be stored and roasted.

03

Revealing the cocoa

From dried beans to roasted cocoa nibs.

6
Step 6 of 11 · 03 Revealing the cocoa

Roasting

Dried beans are roasted in the drum, bringing out the deep aroma and flavour of chocolate.

7
Step 7 of 11 · 03 Revealing the cocoa

Winnowing

The roasted beans are cracked and the husk is separated from the nibs, leaving pure cocoa nibs.

04

Refining the craft

Slow refinement, then carefully prepared chocolate.

8
Step 8 of 11 · 04 Refining the craft

Refining & Conching

The nibs are stone-ground and slowly refined until the mass turns smooth and silky, rounding off flavour and texture.

9
Step 9 of 11 · 04 Refining the craft

Tempering

The chocolate is worked at controlled temperatures so the cocoa butter sets with a glossy finish and a clean snap.

05

Ready for creation

The final form. The beginning of your next creation.

10
Step 10 of 11 · 05 Ready for creation

Moulding

Tempered chocolate is piped or poured into moulds, giving it its final shape.

11
Step 11 of 11 · 05 Ready for creation

Chocolate Setting

The moulded chocolate cools and sets, then comes out of the mould as finished couverture, ready to be packed.

Our approach to craft

Thoughtful ingredients. Unhurried chocolate.

Time, not shortcuts

Traditionally melanged, stone-ground and slowly refined.

The bean comes first

Carefully selected Indian A-grade cocoa beans and pure, thoughtfully chosen ingredients.

Naturally cocoa

Our own cocoa butter, extracted in-house. Non-alkalised cocoa retaining its natural character. Palm oil free.
